slides.title: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct
slides.body: Hugging Face's fully-open small model (open data, open training recipe). A nice contrast to Qwen for side-by-side comparisons.

slides.title: What's special?
slides.body: SmolLM2 is a study in data-centric training: ~11T tokens with new curated datasets (FineMath, Stack-Edu, SmolTalk) and multi-stage data rebalancing. Unlike many 'open weights' releases, the paper and datasets document the full recipe — making it one of the most reproducible small models available.
bullets: Open weights ≠ open science — SmolLM2 aims for both
Dataset curation (math, education, chat) beats brute-force scraping alone
Side-by-side eval with Qwen teaches more than either model alone

slides.title: How it's built
slides.body: Dense decoder-only transformer in the SmolLM lineage. The Instruct variant is tuned on SmolTalk and related chat/instruction mixtures. Context is 8K — shorter than Qwen2.5's 32K, which is a useful trade-off to discuss in class.
bullets: Teaching openness and reproducibility; comparing data recipes against Qwen; Apache 2.0 deployments where you want a fully open stack.

slides.title: Lab goals
slides.body: Finish the notebook when you can explain these in your own words.
bullets: Articulate what 'fully open' means (weights, data, code, paper)
